name: EucRoll
description: Euclidean step roll. Always records AUDIO IN. Touch rolls the current tempo-synced step; Euclidean hits re-capture. X = hit density, Y = roll subdivision inside the step (coarse hold to tight stutter).

params.name: DENS
params.detail: Euclidean hits per bar that re-capture the step

params.name: ROLL
params.detail: Loop subdivision inside the step (1× to 8×)
